senses.gloss: m. (νοταρικόν, sub. μεθόδιον, S.) stenographer’s method, abbreviation.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:5">Sabb. XII, 5</cite> <he>כתב אות אחת נ׳</he> if one wrote (on the Sabbath) one letter as an abbreviation (e. g. <cite ref="S00001"><he>ק׳</he></cite> for <he>קרבן</he>). Ib. 105ᵃ <he>לשון נ׳</he> the acrostic method of speech (ref. to <he>א̇ב̇ ה̇מ̇ו̇ן̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 17:5">Gen. XVII, 5</cite>, <cite ref="A00013"><he>אֹב</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00472"><he>בֹחור</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00051"><he>חֹביב</he></cite>, <he>מֹלך</he>, <cite ref="F00108"><he>וֹתיק</he></cite>, <he>נֹאמן</he>).
<cite ref="Genesis 17:5">Ib.</cite> <he>אנכי נ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A02248"><he>אָנֹכִי</he></cite>; a. fr.—Trnsf. <he>לשון נ׳</he> by a mere hint.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:33">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00873"><he>קִידּוּשׁ</he></cite>
